description: Stage 7: the evidence rule, the displayed state with dwell, hold and Cannot verify and the call-local change check on scripted event lists.

tolerance.exact: every field except T_b, T_next and worst

cases.name: tie_block_sum
cases.description: S = -T_1 = -11.5 exactly, five negative values, median -3.5: Differs (S <= -T_b, not S < -T_b)

cases.name: above_block_sum
cases.description: S = -11.25, one eighth above the threshold: not Differs, but weak (S <= -0.5 T_1 = -5.75)

cases.name: tie_median
cases.description: median exactly -3.0 = -m_min (S = -20, six negative values): Differs (med <= -m_min)

cases.name: above_median
cases.description: median -2.875 (S = -14.75, six negative values): not Differs, the median rule alone decides

cases.name: neg_min
cases.description: with m_min lowered to 0.5 and t_differs to 8 the neg_min rule decides alone: four negative values (zero is not negative) and S = -16 is Differs; three negative values and S = -12 (beyond T_2 = 9.386) is not

cases.name: tie_weak
cases.description: S = -5.75 = -0.5 T_1 exactly is weak (S <= -weak_frac T_b), not Differs; the second block (S = -5.5, T_2 = 12.886) is not weak

cases.name: weak_blocks_matches
cases.description: after a weak block Matches stays off while the next block is open, even with a recent sum above t_match; it comes back when that block closes

cases.name: tie_match
cases.description: R = 6.0 = t_match exactly with two windows: Matches (R >= t_match); the third window takes R to 5.875: Checking

cases.name: match_min_windows
cases.description: t_match lowered to 3.5: one window of 4.0 is not enough (match_min_windows = 2), the second gives Matches

cases.name: tie_partial_block
cases.description: uncertain windows lift R; the open block's sum is -2.875 = -0.25 T_1 exactly: not Matches (it needs a sum above -0.25 T_(b+1))

cases.name: above_partial_block
cases.description: the same with -2.75 in the open block: Matches

cases.name: partial_block_next_threshold
cases.description: after one block (b = 1) the open block is compared with -0.25 T_2 = -3.2216, not -0.25 T_1 = -2.875: a sum of -3.0 still allows Matches, -3.5 does not

cases.name: tail_slope
cases.description: T_b = 11.5 + 2 ln b: from block 2 on, S = -(T_b + 1e-6) is Differs and S = -(T_b - 1e-6) is not (blocks 2 to 5); T_b is compared with a relative tolerance because ln may differ in the last bit

cases.name: flag_off_shadow
cases.description: display.differs false: the candidate is DIFFERS but Checking is shown, logged as shadow

cases.name: max_block
cases.description: six blocks of -24: Differs is shown for b <= max_block = 4; at b = 5 the candidate is still DIFFERS but Checking is shown (shadow)

cases.name: delta_new
cases.description: device not covered: T_1 = 14.5 and S = -11.5 is not Differs; block 2 (T_2 = 15.886, S = -18.5) is, and the Differs shown carries the device_new detail

cases.name: reset_discards_block
cases.description: an accumulator reset discards the partial block but keeps b, recent and worst: after it three more windows do not close a block (it needs six)

cases.name: uncertain_outside_block
cases.description: uncertain windows enter `recent` but never the block: 24 windows alternating certain and uncertain close two blocks, on the 11th and the 23rd window

cases.name: recent_cap
cases.description: `recent` keeps the last 6 values: after seven windows R = 4 x 5 - 4 = 16

cases.name: off_until_consent
cases.description: no consent yet: the window before it is ignored and Off is shown; consent gives Checking at once, then two windows give Matches

cases.name: dwell_exact
cases.description: Matches is shown at t0 + 2 s; the candidate drops at t0 + 3 s but a change needs 10 s after the last one: pending at 1 ns before, applied exactly 10 s after the change

cases.name: differs_hold
cases.description: Differs is shown at the 6th window; six windows of 4 end the DIFFERS candidate 6 s later, but Differs stays at least 20 s: pending 1 ns before, applied exactly at 20 s; `differed` stays set

cases.name: consent_withdrawn
cases.description: consent withdrawn mid-call: Off at once and a window while off is ignored; consent back: the evidence resumes where it was

cases.name: tier_zero
cases.description: tier 0: Matches is shown as Checking, Differs stays possible

cases.name: needs_refresh
cases.description: contact in Needs refresh: the Differs candidate is shown as Checking, logged as shadow

cases.name: route_not_covered
cases.description: route group not covered: the Differs candidate is shown as Checking with the detail different_setup, shadow

cases.name: cannot_verify_audio
cases.description: a window scored at t0 + 1 s; final VAD speech in the last 30 s of 7999 ms (no), 8000 ms (yes, but the window is inside the lookback), and at t0 + 31 s - 1 ns (still inside) and exactly t0 + 31 s (outside: the lookback is (t - 30 s, t]): Cannot verify (audio); then a fault (cpu) replaces the reason

cases.name: cannot_verify_speech_boundary
cases.description: no window has been scored: 7999 ms of speech in the last 30 s is Checking, exactly 8000 ms is Cannot verify (audio); a window scored a second later ends the reason, shown after the 10 s dwell

cases.name: cannot_verify_not_over_matches
cases.description: a fault does not override Matches or Differs: Matches stays with fault = path, and the Differs of the next block is shown

cases.name: cannot_verify_reasons
cases.description: Checking with a fault shows Cannot verify with that reason (locked, model, constants, cpu, path)

cases.name: media_start_resets
cases.description: media start resets everything (b, blocks, recent, flags, display, context): the new call starts from Off

cases.name: cl_changed_hold
cases.description: call-local: six windows of -4 against the reference are a change candidate, shown as Changed (display.change true); the same 20 s hold as Differs applies; Matches does not exist in this mode

cases.name: cl_flag_off
cases.description: display.change false: Learning stays, the candidate is logged as shadow

cases.name: cl_own_constants
cases.description: call-local constants: t_change 8 and m_min 1.5 give a change on six windows of -2 (S = -12 <= -8, median -2 <= -1.5) that the main rule (m_min = 3) would not

cases.name: cl_own_tail_neg
cases.description: call-local tail_slope 2 and neg_min 3 (m_min 1.5): block 1 has three negative values (S = -12, median -2) and is a change, which neg_min 4 would refuse; T_b = 11.5 + ln b, so S = -(T_b + 1e-6) is a change for b = 2 and 4 (the main section's T_b would be 12.886 and 14.273) and S = -(T_3 - 1e-6) is not

cases.name: cl_max_block
cases.description: call-local max_block lowered to 2: a change is shown for b <= 2 and not from b = 3 on

cases.name: walk_verify
cases.description: pseudo-random sequence of 150 events (seed 0x7701)

cases.name: walk_call_local
cases.description: pseudo-random sequence of 120 events (seed 0x7702)
